Council votes to keep the pool open

By Priya Nair, local democracy reporter
15 Jul 2026

The borough council voted eighteen to eleven on Tuesday night to keep the Fairfield leisure centre open until at least 2029.

The pool had been listed for closure in a draft budget published in January, which put the annual subsidy at four hundred thousand pounds.
